data.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
This task satisfies:
- DD2: tests confirm enforcement.strategy=ci causes all gating PreToolUse hooks to short-circuit with HOOK_GATE: skipped reason=enforcement.strategy=ci log
- DD3: tests confirm structural integrity hooks run regardless of enforcement.strategy value
- DD4: tests confirm enforcement.strategy=both does NOT cause hook logic to run twice
- DD5: tests confirm HOOK_GATE log line schema is identical across all gating hooks

## TDD Requirement
This IS the RED test task. Write the following failing tests in tests/hooks/test-enforcement-gate.sh:
- test_enforcement_ci_review_gate_skips: Given pre-commit-review-gate.sh invoked in tmpdir with enforcement.strategy=ci in config; When hook runs (bash pre-commit-review-gate.sh); Then stdout/stderr contains 'HOOK_GATE: skipped reason=enforcement.strategy=ci'. FAILS: enforcement.strategy not implemented in hook; HOOK_GATE log not emitted.
- test_enforcement_ci_test_gate_skips: Same as above for pre-commit-test-gate.sh. FAILS: same.
- test_enforcement_ci_test_quality_gate_skips: Same for pre-commit-test-quality-gate.sh. FAILS: same.
- test_structural_check_plugin_self_ref_runs_on_ci: Given enforcement.strategy=ci; When check-plugin-self-ref hook runs on staged file with a literal plugins/dso/ path; Then hook exits 1 (blocks commit), DOES NOT emit HOOK_GATE: skipped. FAILS: structural vs gating distinction not implemented.
- test_structural_check_portability_runs_on_ci: Same for check-portability.sh. FAILS: same.
- test_enforcement_both_no_double_execution: Given enforcement.strategy=both; When pre-commit-review-gate.sh runs; Then hook invocation count = 1 (use tmpdir counter file). FAILS: not implemented.
- test_hook_gate_schema_review_gate: Given HOOK_GATE emitted by pre-commit-review-gate.sh; Then format is exactly 'HOOK_GATE: skipped reason=enforcement.strategy=ci' (no extra fields, no trailing text). FAILS: HOOK_GATE not yet emitted.
- test_hook_gate_schema_test_gate: Given HOOK_GATE emitted by pre-commit-test-gate.sh; Then format matches review gate format exactly. FAILS: same.

## Implementation Notes
- Mock read-config: create tmpdir/.claude/dso-config.conf with enforcement.strategy=ci; set PROJECT_ROOT=$_TMPDIR
- Invoke hooks via subprocess: bash plugins/dso/hooks/pre-commit-review-gate.sh 2>&1
- For structural hooks: create a staged file with a literal plugins/dso/ path; verify hook still blocks
- Use assert_eq and assert_contains from tests/lib/assert.sh
- File naming: tests/hooks/test-enforcement-gate.sh (fuzzy-match compatible: 'enforcementgate' substring check against hook files may need .test-index entry)

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] tests/hooks/test-enforcement-gate.sh exists and is executable
  Verify: test -x tests/hooks/test-enforcement-gate.sh
- [ ] File contains all 8 test functions by exact name
  Verify: grep -qc 'test_enforcement_ci_review_gate_skips\|test_enforcement_ci_test_gate_skips\|test_enforcement_ci_test_quality_gate_skips\|test_structural_check_plugin_self_ref_runs_on_ci\|test_structural_check_portability_runs_on_ci\|test_enforcement_both_no_double_execution\|test_hook_gate_schema_review_gate\|test_hook_gate_schema_test_gate' tests/hooks/test-enforcement-gate.sh
- [ ] .test-index entry maps pre-commit-review-gate.sh to test-enforcement-gate.sh (fuzzy match may not fire; explicit entry required)
  Verify: grep -q 'pre-commit-review-gate.sh.*test-enforcement-gate.sh\|test_enforcement_ci_review_gate_skips' "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index"
- [ ] Tests assert on subprocess output, not source-file grep patterns
  Verify: ! grep -qE '^[^#]*grep.*hooks/pre-commit' tests/hooks/test-enforcement-gate.sh
- [ ] bash -n syntax check passes
  Verify: bash -n tests/hooks/test-enforcement-gate.sh
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD || true

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
data.title: Create RED tests: enforcement.strategy hook gating, structural hooks always-on, HOOK_GATE schema consistency
